tests.name: Keyboard never hides a field
tests.assertion: For /login, /signup, /search, the feedback form (/grievance), Profile edit and every /post step: the LOWEST text field, tapped with a real on-screen keyboard drawn, is fully visible above the keyboard (a), its submit/next button scrolls into view with the keyboard up (b), and after closing the keyboard nothing stays covered (c). Forms needing an account are NOT-RUN where no login is allowed (prod)
tests.notes: 4 forms measured; NOT-RUN here: /post (steps 2 and 3); /profile — need a logged-in account; the prod flavour is read-only (no account may be created or used)
